caption: A lawn sprinkler sends jets of water up and out over a garden, and the water falls onto the grass some distance away.

sa.check: A lawn sprinkler is running in a garden.
It sends jets of water up and outward.
The water comes down on the grass some distance from the sprinkler.
There are several jets rather than one.

pc.expect: Each jet leaves the sprinkler along one direction and curves over in an arc.
pc.fail: A jet travels in a straight line to the ground; or it bends upward in mid-air; or it kinks.

pc.expect: The water comes down after the peak and lands, and the higher jets land further out.
pc.fail: Water hangs at the top of an arc; or it rises again after starting to fall; or it lands and lifts off the grass.

pc.expect: The jets break into drops and spray as they fall, and the grass darkens and glistens where they land.
pc.fail: The jets are rigid rods; or the grass stays dry where the water lands; or the water gathers into balls.

pc.expect: The sprinkler head turns or oscillates steadily and the pattern moves with it, while the sprinkler itself stays put.
pc.fail: The sprinkler slides across the lawn; or the jets jump between directions unrelated to the head; or the head stops and the jets keep sweeping.

pc.expect: One sprinkler is the only source of water.
pc.fail: A second sprinkler appears; or water appears from nowhere away from the head; or the sprinkler turns into another object.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The sprinkler, the lawn and the garden stay the same.
pc.fail: The sprinkler changes colour or shape; or the lawn changes texture between frames; or the garden behind rearranges.
